manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Defeat Invasion of Alara, causing you to exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstrom without paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Awaken the Maelstrom at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Awaken the Maelstrom spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom
uses.cardState: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Alara.
